sources.entry: flask-restx - Fully featured framework for fast, easy and documented API development with Flask.

summary.one_liner: Flask-RESTX is a community-maintained fork of Flask-RESTPlus that adds tooling for building REST APIs with Flask and documenting them with Swagger.
summary.what_it_does: Flask-RESTX is an extension for Flask that provides decorators and tools for quickly building REST APIs. It lets you define namespaces, routes (via Resource classes), and data models, and describe your API so its documentation is exposed through Swagger. Endpoints can declare expected input with expect and shape output with marshal_with / marshal_list_with. The quick start shows a TodoMVC-style CRUD API with a model, namespace, parameter and response documentation, and abort handling. The README also covers installation via pip and links to hosted documentation on Read the Docs.
use_cases: documenting a Flask API with Swagger
formatting API responses from data models
creating a CRUD todo-style web service
notable: Namespaces and reusable models for organizing endpoints
Quick start example implementing a full CRUD API
caveats: Flask 2.0+ compatibility changes from earlier versions; older Flask-RESTX releases need Flask 1.3 or earlier
